analogy.rationale: MEK inhibitors block the RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK cascade, so RAF and MAP kinase inhibitors act on the same pathway and should give highly similar responses; upstream receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitors (EGFR, protein tyrosine kinase) and PI3K inhibitors converge on overlapping growth/survival programs.
